v0.6.5
Please read the README: https://github.com/chiaki-ng/akirareadme and the documentation: https://xlanor.github.io/akira before getting started.



 What's Changed
- redo stream menu + fix a couple of bugs by @xlanor in https://github.com/chiaki-ng/akira/pull/87
- With thanks to grill2010, co-op by @xlanor in https://github.com/chiaki-ng/akira/pull/88
- update setting helpers by @xlanor in https://github.com/chiaki-ng/akira/pull/89
- decouple polling to non-render thread, clean up synchronization between various locations by @xlanor in https://github.com/chiaki-ng/akira/pull/90
- throttle empty direct-device discovery by @xlanor in https://github.com/chiaki-ng/akira/pull/91
- fix: support transient PS4 remote play over PSN by @xlanor in https://github.com/chiaki-ng/akira/pull/93
- Logging handlers by @xlanor in https://github.com/chiaki-ng/akira/pull/94
- show fsr in fsr-overlay by @xlanor in https://github.com/chiaki-ng/akira/pull/95
- adjust overlays for co-op by @xlanor in https://github.com/chiaki-ng/akira/pull/96
- optimized wg-nx + fixed ps4 relay bug (thx to ItzMeGab) by @xlanor in https://github.com/chiaki-ng/akira/pull/98
- startup DNS check, so that we don't waste any more time with 90DNS users. by @xlanor in https://github.com/chiaki-ng/akira/pull/99
- entitlements logic from chaz over at Cloudpad

v0.6.0
Please read the README: https://github.com/xlanor/akirareadme and the documentation: https://xlanor.github.io/akira before getting started.

 What's Changed
Cloud streaming. 
Multiple PSN accounts 
Trophy support, 
Companion app rewritten as a native desktop app with Wails v2.
Auto-registration over PSN through holepunch (dependent on holepunch succeeding) with fallback to 8 digit pin
Cross-subnet discovery by unicast sweep, capped at /24.

UI might look slightly different too.

I got no feedback from the rcs, releasing as is.

FSR Screens:














Dithering (for color banding) and FSR (720p->1080p, 540p->720p) are now avaliable under settings.

FSR is decomposed into two settings: selecting FSR from the resolution will enable EASU, while sharpness is left as an independent setting that you can use without EASU

If you encounter issues, please turn them off.

 What's Changed
- debanding by @xlanor in https://github.com/xlanor/akira/pull/58
- debug: add ipc server for overlay debug by @xlanor in https://github.com/xlanor/akira/pull/59
- implement fsr 1.0 by @xlanor and @kelvin8906 in https://github.com/xlanor/akira/pull/60
